## Variance partitioning analysis

## Clear workspace and set directory

```{r setup}
rm(list=ls())
getwd()
setwd("~/GitHub/irrigation/Beta_diversity")
```

# Load packages

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(geosphere)
```


# select non-irrigated samples

```{r}
design <- read.csv("./Variance_partitioning_analysis/Data/Metadata.csv", header = T,row.names = 1)
# Select irrigated  samples
irrigated.sample <- rownames(design)[design$Irrigation == "irrigated"]
# Choose non-irrigated samples
unirrigated.sample <- rownames(design)[design$Irrigation == "non-irrigated"]

set.seed(1234)
comm_data01 <- read.csv("./Variance_partitioning_analysis/Data/RPKM.species.abundance.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
comm_data02 <- comm_data01[,rownames(design)]
comm.irr <- comm_data02[,irrigated.sample]
comm.unirr <- comm_data02[,unirrigated.sample]

# Soil properties
env_data.all <- read.csv("./Variance_partitioning_analysis/Data/Soil_properties_gb_imputed.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
env_data.all.unirr <- env_data.all[unirrigated.sample,]

# Spatial data (PCNM1, PCNM2)
pcnm_vectors <- env_data.all.unirr[,c(1,2)]
# Climatic data
climate <- env_data.all.unirr[,c(37,38)]
```


# Variation partitioning analysis of taxonomic communities in non-irrigated fields

```{r}
#===========================check collinearity=================================
# remove factors with vif > 20
# pure soil physico-chemical properties
colnames(env_data.all.unirr)
env_data.unirr <- env_data.all.unirr[ ,-c(1,2,3,6,7,8,10:12,13:16,18,19,28:38)]
env_data.norm.unirr <- scale(env_data.unirr)
colnames(env_data.all.unirr)

# Combine variables
explanatory_vars <- cbind(pcnm_vectors, env_data.norm.unirr, climate)

# Hellinger transformation
comm_data_hel <- decostand(comm.unirr, method = "hellinger")

# Initial and complete models
rda_null <- rda(t(comm_data_hel) ~ 1, data = explanatory_vars)
rda_full <- rda(t(comm_data_hel) ~ ., data = explanatory_vars)

# Check for multicollinearity; ensure that the VIF for all variables is less than 20
vif_result <- vif.cca(rda_full)
print(round(vif_result, 3))  # keep factors with vif < 20, which indicates non-collinear factors.

# non-irrigated samples
comm.unirr <- comm_data02[,unirrigated.sample]
# Calculate Bray-Curtis
comm_dist <- vegdist(t(comm.unirr), method = "bray")

# Select non-collinear soil properties for the variance partitioning analysis.
env_data.norm.sig <- env_data.norm.unirr[,c('SM.M10','bulk.density','pH','Mn','Fe','Zn','Cu','Sand','Aggregate.stability','gravperc_loss')] # 'pH','gravperc_loss','Aggregate.stability'

# env_data plus climate
env_data.norm.climate <- cbind(env_data.norm.sig, as.matrix(climate))


#=========================Variation partioning analysis (VPA)===========================
# Community hellinger transformation
comm_data_hel <- decostand(t(comm.unirr), method = "hellinger")

# Model VPA of Soil properties, spatial effect, climatic factors
varpart_result <- varpart(
  comm_data_hel,                  # community data
  env_data.norm.sig,              # soil property effect
  as.matrix(pcnm_vectors$PCNM2),  # spatial effect
  as.matrix(climate)              # climatic effect
)

print(varpart_result)
png(filename = "./Variance_partitioning_analysis/Output/Variation_partitioning_Taxonomy_non-irrigated.png", width = 2400, height = 2000, res = 300)
plot(varpart_result, bg = c("hotpink","skyblue","forestgreen","yellow"))
dev.off()


# Model VPA of environmental effect, climatic factors
varpart_result02 <- varpart(
  comm_data_hel,            # community data
  env_data.norm.climate,    # The combined effect of soil and climate is perceived as the total environmental effect.
  as.matrix(pcnm_vectors$PCNM2)
)

print(varpart_result02)
plot(varpart_result02, bg = c("hotpink","skyblue","forestgreen"))

# Species sorting effect
pure_env <- varpart_result02$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[1]  
# Spatial-related effect refers to dispersal limitation effect
pure_space <- varpart_result02$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[2]

# The ratio of species sorting to dispersal limitation effect (SDER)
sder <- pure_env / pure_space  # 8.99

cat("Pure environmental effect (species sorting):", pure_env, "\n")
cat("Pure spatial effect (dispersal limitation):", pure_space, "\n")
cat("SDER (Species Sorting to Dispersal Limitation Effect Ratio):", sder, "\n")

```


# Variation partitioning analysis of taxonomic communities in irrigated fields

```{r}
# Select irrigated  samples
irrigated.sample <- rownames(design)[design$Irrigation == "irrigated"]

#==========================Taxonomic communities===========================
# Import taxonomic abundance data
set.seed(1234)
comm_data01 <- read.csv("./Variance_partitioning_analysis/Data/RPKM.species.abundance.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
comm_data02 <- comm_data01[,rownames(design)]
comm.irr <- comm_data02[,irrigated.sample]
comm.unirr <- comm_data02[,unirrigated.sample]

# Environmental Data (Physicochemical, and Climatic)
env_data.all <- read.csv("./Variance_partitioning_analysis/Data/Soil_properties_gb_imputed.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
env_data.all.irr <- env_data.all[irrigated.sample,]
colnames(env_data.all.irr)

# Spatial and climatic data
pcnm_vectors <- env_data.all.irr[,c(1,2)]
climate <- env_data.all.irr[,c(37,38)]


#==========================Checking for collinearity================================
# Remove variables with severe multicollinearity (VIF > 20)
# Pure soil physico-chemical properties
colnames(env_data.all.irr)
env_data.irr <- env_data.all.irr[ ,-c(1,2,3,6,7,10,12:18,19,23,28,29,30,31,33:38)]
env_data.norm.irr <- scale(env_data.irr)  # -c(1,2,3,6,7,10,11,12,14:19,23,27,29,33:38)
colnames(env_data.norm.irr)

# Combine Explanatory Variables
explanatory_vars <- cbind(pcnm_vectors[2], env_data.norm.irr, climate)
# Hellinger transformation
comm_data_hel <- decostand(comm.irr, method = "hellinger")

# Initial and complete models; species data rows are labeled by species name
rda_null <- rda(t(comm_data_hel) ~ 1, data = explanatory_vars)
rda_full <- rda(t(comm_data_hel) ~ ., data = explanatory_vars)

# Checking for Collinearity
vif_result <- vif.cca(rda_full)
print(round(vif_result, 3))   # keep factors with vif < 20, which indicates non-collinear factors.


# Select irrigated samples
comm.irr <- comm_data02[,irrigated.sample]
# Bray-Curtis distance
comm_dist <- vegdist(t(comm.irr), method = "bray")

# Select non-collinear soil properties for the variance partitioning analysis.
env_data.norm.sig <- env_data.norm.irr[,c('SM.M10','bulk.density','CN_ratio','pH','OM','Mn','Fe','Zn','Cu','Sand',
                                          'Aggregate.stability','gravperc_loss','K_PerC')]
# env_data plus climate
env_data.norm.climate <- cbind(env_data.norm.sig, as.matrix(climate))


#=====================Variation partioning analysis==========================
# Community hellinger transformation
comm_data_hel <- decostand(t(comm.irr), method = "hellinger")

# Model VPA of Soil properties, spatial effect, climatic factors
varpart_result <- varpart(
  comm_data_hel,                  # community data
  env_data.norm.sig,              # soil property effect
  as.matrix(pcnm_vectors$PCNM1),  # spatial effect
  as.matrix(climate)              # climatic effect
)

print(varpart_result)
png(filename = "./Variance_partitioning_analysis/Output/Variation_partitioning_Taxonomy_irrigated.png", width = 2400, height = 2000, res = 300)
plot(varpart_result, bg = c("hotpink","skyblue","forestgreen","yellow"))
dev.off()

# Model VPA of environmental effect, climatic factors
varpart_result02 <- varpart(
  comm_data_hel,            # community data
  env_data.norm.climate,    # The combined effect of soil and climate is perceived as the total environmental effect.
  as.matrix(pcnm_vectors$PCNM1)
)

print(varpart_result02)
plot(varpart_result02, bg = c("hotpink","skyblue","forestgreen"))


# Extract environmental effects and spatial effects
pure_env <- varpart_result02$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[1]
pure_space <- varpart_result02$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[2] 

# calculate SDER
sder <- pure_env / pure_space  # 13.5 : 1

cat("Pure environmental effect (species sorting):", pure_env, "\n")
cat("Pure spatial effect (dispersal limitation):", pure_space, "\n")
cat("SDER (Species Sorting to Dispersal Limitation Effect Ratio):", sder, "\n")
```


# Variation partitioning analysis of functional communities in non-irrigated fields

```{r}

comm.unirr <- comm_data02[,unirrigated.sample]

# Spatial data (PCNM1, PCNM2)
pcnm_vectors <- env_data.all.unirr[,c(1,2)]
# Climatic data
climate <- env_data.all.unirr[,c(37,38)]


#===========================check collinearity=================================
# remove factors with vif > 20
# pure soil physico-chemical properties
colnames(env_data.all.unirr)
env_data.unirr <- env_data.all.unirr[ ,-c(1,2,3,6,7,8,10:12,13:16,18,19,28:38)]
env_data.norm.unirr <- scale(env_data.unirr)
colnames(env_data.all.unirr)

# Combine variables
explanatory_vars <- cbind(pcnm_vectors, env_data.norm.unirr, climate)

# Hellinger transformation
comm_data_hel <- decostand(comm.unirr, method = "hellinger")

# Initial and complete models
rda_null <- rda(t(comm_data_hel) ~ 1, data = explanatory_vars)
rda_full <- rda(t(comm_data_hel) ~ ., data = explanatory_vars)

# Check for multicollinearity; ensure that the VIF for all variables is less than 20
vif_result <- vif.cca(rda_full)
print(round(vif_result, 3))  # keep factors with vif < 20, which indicates non-collinear factors.

# non-irrigated samples
comm.unirr <- comm_data02[,unirrigated.sample]
# Calculate Bray-Curtis
comm_dist <- vegdist(t(comm.unirr), method = "bray")

# Select non-collinear soil properties for the variance partitioning analysis.
env_data.norm.sig <- env_data.norm.unirr[,c('SM.M10','bulk.density','pH','Mn','Fe','Zn','Cu','Sand','Aggregate.stability','gravperc_loss')] # 'pH','gravperc_loss','Aggregate.stability'

# env_data plus climate
env_data.norm.climate <- cbind(env_data.norm.sig, as.matrix(climate))


#=========================Variation partioning analysis (VPA)===========================
# Community hellinger transformation
comm_data_hel <- decostand(t(comm.unirr), method = "hellinger")

# Model VPA of Soil properties, spatial effect, climatic factors
varpart_result <- varpart(
  comm_data_hel,                  # community data
  env_data.norm.sig,              # soil property effect
  as.matrix(pcnm_vectors$PCNM2),  # spatial effect
  as.matrix(climate)              # climatic effect
)

print(varpart_result)
png(filename = "./Variance_partitioning_analysis/Output/Variation_partitioning_Function_non-irrigated.png", width = 2400, height = 2000, res = 300)
plot(varpart_result, bg = c("hotpink","skyblue","forestgreen","yellow"))
dev.off()


# Model VPA of environmental effect, climatic factors
varpart_result02 <- varpart(
  comm_data_hel,            # community data
  env_data.norm.climate,    # The combined effect of soil and climate is perceived as the total environmental effect.
  as.matrix(pcnm_vectors$PCNM2)
)

print(varpart_result02)
plot(varpart_result02, bg = c("hotpink","skyblue","forestgreen"))

# Species sorting effect
pure_env <- varpart_result02$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[1]  
# Spatial-related effect refers to dispersal limitation effect
pure_space <- varpart_result02$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[2]

# The ratio of species sorting to dispersal limitation effect (SDER)
sder <- pure_env / pure_space  # 9.63

cat("Pure environmental effect (species sorting):", pure_env, "\n")
cat("Pure spatial effect (dispersal limitation):", pure_space, "\n")
cat("SDER (Species Sorting to Dispersal Limitation Effect Ratio):", sder, "\n")

```

#=============Plot the result of selection / dispersal effect ratio (SDER)============

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
data <- data.frame(value = c(13.5, 8.99, 11.69,9.63),
                   group = c("Taxonomy","Taxonomy","Function","Function"),
                   Treatment = c("Irrigated","non-irrigated","Irrigated","non-irrigated"))
data$group <- factor(data$group, levels = c("Taxonomy","Function"))

theme_set(theme_bw())
p01 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = group, y = value)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = Treatment), stat = "identity", position = "dodge", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4169B2", "#BB2BA0")) +
  xlab("") + 
  ylab("Selection / dispersal effect ratio") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black"))

p01
ggsave("./Variance_partitioning_analysis/Output/Selection - dispersal effect ratio.pdf", p01, width = 5, height = 5)
```
